10 countries, 10 responses, nearly 900,000 hot meals per day.
Yesterday alone, on October 14, WCK teams around the world served almost 900,000 meals to communities in need. Read more about the work we’re doing and the families we’re supporting around the globe. ⬇️

📍ALASKA — The remnants of Typhoon Halong flooded several villages—including Napakiak, Kipnuk, Kwigillingok, and Chefornak—along Alaska’s southwest coast. WCK is supporting first responders conducting search and rescue operations, as well as people displaced from their homes. Many families have been relocated to shelters in Bethel, a hub accessible only by air, river, or 4-wheelers.
📍CALIFORNIA — WCK’s commissary kitchen in Los Angeles remains open 10 months after the Eaton and Palisades fires hit local communities. Chefs and restaurants lost their kitchens, making it hard to rebuild. By keeping our commissary kitchen running, we’ve provided a space for chefs to restart cooking and breathe new life into their businesses.
📍TENNESSEE — WCK is on the ground in Waverly after the deadly explosion at the AES munitions plant. Working with WCK Chef Corps members Chef Julio Hernandez of Maiz de la Vida and Chef Lauren Morales of TomKats Hospitality, our teams are serving meals to first responders and families mourning loved ones at a local church.
📍MEXICO — In Veracruz, WCK teams responded within hours to flooding caused by heavy rains. We’re serving thousands of hot meals in Poza Rica and Álamo and are expanding to new areas as floodwaters recede. Our teams have also started delivering by air, bringing sandwiches to families still cut off from aid.
📍HAITI — For five months, WCK and our partner HAS Haiti have supported communities in Verrettes, serving meals to families displaced from Petite Rivière by ongoing violence. We're sourcing ingredients from local farmers and suppliers which helps strengthen the local economy while providing hot, home-style meals.
📍SPAIN — In Catalonia, communities have faced flash flooding from DANA Alice. WCK teams are in La Ràpita, Godall, and other hard-hit towns, serving meals to first responders, volunteers, and families returning home to begin cleanup. Working with local restaurant partners, we’ll continue supporting recovery efforts however we can.
📍UKRAINE — As Russian attacks intensified, WCK Emergency Response Teams served meals and warm drinks in Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, Lviv, Khmelnytskyi, Odesa, and Kharkiv. With winter approaching, we’re shifting to support families through the cold months ahead.
📍MIDDLE EAST — Across the region, WCK teams are serving warm, comforting meals to communities in need. In Israel, we’re supporting released hostages and their families. In Lebanon, chefs at WCK-supported kitchens prepare tens of thousands of meals weekly. In Gaza, we’re scaling up toward 1 million meals per day, currently serving 500,000+ meals and 115,000 loaves of bread daily through our field kitchens and bakeries.
📍PAKISTAN — WCK and our partner Rizq have served more than 3.5 million meals to families affected by monsoon flooding. We’re providing both hot meals and food kits, helping families returning home cook for themselves again with supplies that last several days.
📍PHILIPPINES — In northern Cebu, WCK teams are supporting communities hit by a 6.9 magnitude earthquake. Many families remain outside their homes due to ongoing aftershocks or have sought shelter along main roads. We've scaled up quickly to serve hot meals to as many people as possible.

Read the latest about our efforts at https://t.co/XRHg40Bxpc.
